description: This Scala source file defines an abstract class 'CompactibleFileStreamLog' for managing compactible metadata logs in Spark Streaming. It handles log serialization, deserialization, batching, compaction, and cleanup, specifically for streaming batch logs with support for log file merging and retention policies.

classes.name: CompactibleFileStreamLog
classes.description: An abstract class for managing compactible metadata logs in Spark Streaming, supporting log serialization, deserialization, batching, compaction, and cleanup.

methods.name: batchIdToPath
methods.description: Converts a batch ID to its corresponding file system path, appending a suffix if it's a compaction batch.

methods.name: pathToBatchId
methods.description: Extracts the batch ID from a given file path.

methods.name: isBatchFile
methods.description: Checks if a given path corresponds to a batch file based on filename format.

methods.name: serializeEntry
methods.description: Serializes a log entry of type T into an OutputStream as JSON.

methods.name: deserializeEntry
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into a log entry of type T.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an array of log entries into an OutputStream, including version info.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes an InputStream into an array of log entries, validating version.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new batch of logs; performs compaction if batch is a compaction batch.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Throws an error; purging is handled internally by the class.

methods.name: foreachInBatch
methods.description: Applies a function to all entries in a specific batch.

methods.name: filterInBatch
methods.description: Filters entries in a batch based on a predicate.

methods.name: applyFnInBatch
methods.description: Internal method to apply a function to entries in a batch.

methods.name: compact
methods.description: Performs log compaction for a batch, merging logs and writing to storage.

methods.name: allFiles
methods.description: Retrieves all valid log files, handling race conditions and retries.

methods.name: deleteExpiredLog
methods.description: Deletes expired log files based on retention policies and timestamps.
